mcq.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of React?
mcq.explanation: React uses one-way data binding. Two-way binding is typical of Angular.

mcq.question: What does === check in JavaScript?
mcq.explanation: Strict equality compares both value and type without coercion.

mcq.question: Which HTTP status indicates a resource was successfully created?
mcq.explanation: 201 Created means a new resource was created.

coding.title: Two Sum
coding.problemStatement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
coding.inputFormat: First line contains target. Second line contains comma-separated array numbers.
coding.outputFormat: Two indices as comma-separated values, e.g. '0,1'.
hints: Use a hash map for O(1) lookups.

Complete the analogy: LION : PRIDE :: WOLF : ?
aptitude.explanation: A group of wolves is called a pack.
